purpose: Close the only omitted term in the high-rate recruitment logit and determine whether the observed reduction in base mobilization intensity is carried primarily by rootedness congruence or by a change in the compatibility composition of the enlarged recruitable pool.
decision_rule_for_next_hypothesis: If the rootedness-congruence contribution has the largest absolute mean paired contribution over post-anchor weekly observations and compatibility is materially smaller, promote a rootedness-composition feedback hypothesis to fresh-seed testing.
If compatibility is comparable to or larger than rootedness, frame the mechanism more broadly as recruitable-pool composition rather than rootedness specifically.
If neither term explains the mean-logit shift, do not promote the throttling mechanism without further decomposition.
integrity: High-rate day240 legacy outputs must reproduce the existing weekly decomposition/phase-map state.
The weighted mean-logit identity must close to floating-point tolerance.
This is known-seed mechanism selection and is not confirmatory evidence.
